model.jaffle_shop.stg_orders.name: stg_orders
model.jaffle_shop.stg_orders.compiled_code:
select
    id as order_id,
    user_id as customer_id,
    order_date,
    status,
    amount
from raw_orders

model.jaffle_shop.stg_customers.name: stg_customers
model.jaffle_shop.stg_customers.compiled_code:
select
    id as customer_id,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    country_code
from raw_customers

model.jaffle_shop.int_customer_country.name: int_customer_country
model.jaffle_shop.int_customer_country.raw_code: select c.*, cc.country_name from {{ ref('stg_customers') }} c left join {{ ref('country_codes') }} cc on c.country_code = cc.code
model.jaffle_shop.int_customer_country.compiled_code:
select
    c.customer_id,
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    cc.country_name
from stg_customers c
left join country_codes cc on c.country_code = cc.code

model.jaffle_shop.customers.name: customers
model.jaffle_shop.customers.compiled_code:
select
    c.customer_id,
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    c.country_name,
    count(o.order_id) as order_count,
    sum(o.amount) as lifetime_value,
    min(o.order_date) as first_order_date
from int_customer_country c
left join stg_orders o on o.customer_id = c.customer_id
group by 1, 2, 3, 4

model.jaffle_shop.fct_orders.name: fct_orders
model.jaffle_shop.fct_orders.raw_code: select * from {{ ref('stg_orders') }} {% if is_incremental() %} where order_date > (select max(order_date) from {{ this }}) {% endif %}
model.jaffle_shop.fct_orders.compiled_code:
select
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    order_date,
    status,
    amount
from stg_orders
where order_date > (select max(order_date) from "jaffle"."analytics"."fct_orders")

model.jaffle_shop.order_status_counts.name: order_status_counts
model.jaffle_shop.order_status_counts.raw_code: select status, count(*) as n from {{ ref('fct_orders') }} group by 1
model.jaffle_shop.order_status_counts.compiled_code:
select
    status,
    count(*) as order_count,
    sum(amount) as total_amount
from fct_orders
group by 1

test.jaffle_shop.unique_customers_custom.name: unique_customers_customer_id
test.jaffle_shop.unique_customers_custom.compiled_code: select customer_id from dim_customers group by 1 having count(*) > 1
